purpose: Strict test of independently authored idol-working-life rehearsal scene. These agent tests are separate from requester-owned locks, source admission and generic managed gates.

criteria.required_visible: The lead and two coordinated fellow performers appear in the same stage production space, with a clearly recognizable microphone plus visible rehearsal floor marks and crew involvement. A portrait or merely stage-colored background fails.
criteria.pass_rule: Every stated scene component and its group-working relation is visible together.

criteria.required_visible: A distinct floor manager faces the performers with a clearly readable raised count hand; lead attention is directed toward that cue and her microphone is near the mouth; rear performers wait in the same rehearsal event.
criteria.pass_rule: Cue owner, hand configuration, lead attention and group relation must all be visibly connected; ambiguous or partially hidden cue/attention fails.

criteria.required_visible: The lead face is large and clear enough to assess the soft oval outline, dark eyes and chin-length dark bob with wispy fringe against the provided reference.
criteria.pass_rule: All major face/hair cues are visibly assessable; report resemblance as appearance continuity, not identity. Small or obscured face is UNOBSERVABLE.

criteria.required_visible: Lead right hand and mic grip are coherent, left arm ownership is clear, support foot is on or over the visible X with the other heel slightly lifted, and manager hand belongs to a continuous arm without body merging.
criteria.pass_rule: Every component is visible and plausible together. A cropped foot or ambiguous contact is UNOBSERVABLE and cannot pass.

criteria.required_visible: Lead remains dominant and full length while cue hand and rear group remain readable; stage work context survives the lead face/hair reference.
criteria.pass_rule: All three attention levels coexist clearly; losing a necessary relation to crop, blur or scale fails.

non_pixel_claims: The precise fictional age, a preceding missed cue, a restart as temporal fact and actual idol employment cannot be established from a single image.
Control technical binding, perceived appeal, overall artistic judgment and user preference will be reported separately.
A PASS requires complete visible evidence; partial means FAIL for the complete criterion and missing observability is UNOBSERVABLE.
